versions.changelog:
- Require Alibaba Cloud CLI >= 3.3.3 with AI-Mode support and plugin updates for all executions.
- All cloud service calls now use explicit AI-Mode user agent labeling for responsible traceability.
- Add ability to update (replace/restore) HTTPS listener certificates, including automatic detection and rollback to the correct certificate.
- Expand RAM permissions: now includes `UpdateListenerAttribute` and `DeleteUserCertificate`.
- Add new `scripts/update_listener.sh` for automation of listener certificate changes.
- Update documentation: more precise prerequisites, expanded workflows, and new step-by-step procedures reflecting the above changes.

- Initial beta release of the skill for configuring HTTP-to-HTTPS redirects on Alibaba Cloud ALB.
- Supports inspecting current ALB listener and rule setup, and creating missing HTTP/HTTPS listeners as needed.
- Adds redirect rules to force HTTP (port 80) traffic to HTTPS (port 443).
- Includes detailed authentication, permission, and workflow instructions.
- Requires Alibaba Cloud CLI (>= 3.3.1) with relevant plugins and proper credentials.
